mapper.select: SELECT m.metric_value FROM analysis_metric m JOIN analysis_job j ON j.analysis_id = m.analysis_id WHERE j.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.metric_name = 'callResolutionRate' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE top AS ( SELECT symbol_id, symbol_id AS top_id FROM analysis_symbol WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND outer_symbol_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.symbol_id, t.top_id FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN top t ON s.outer_symbol_id = t.symbol_id WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} ), owner AS ( SELECT t.symbol_id AS id, t.top_id FROM top t UNION ALL SELECT m.method_id, t.top_id FROM analysis_method m JOIN top t ON t.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} UNION ALL SELECT f.field_id, t.top_id FROM analysis_field f JOIN top t ON t.symbol_id = f.owner_symbol_id WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} ), hit AS ( SELECT DISTINCT tgt.top_id FROM analysis_relation r JOIN owner tgt ON tgt.id = r.to_id LEFT JOIN owner src ON src.id = r.from_id WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.to_id IS NOT NULL AND (src.top_id IS NULL OR src.top_id <> tgt.top_id) ), entry AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.top_id FROM analysis_endpoint e JOIN top t ON t.symbol_id = e.symbol_id WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} ), unresolved AS ( SELECT regexp_replace(name, '^.*\.', '') AS simple_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM analysis_reference WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND status IN ('UNRESOLVED', 'HEURISTIC') AND ref_kind IN ('TYPE_USE', 'CREATE', 'EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS', 'THROWS', 'ANONYMOUS_SUPER') GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT s.symbol_id AS "id" , s.fqn AS "name" , s.kind AS "kind" , s.layer AS "layer" , f.path AS "path" , s.line_start AS "line" , (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT a.annotation_name, ',') FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = s.revision_id AND a.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND a.target_id = s.symbol_id) AS "annotations" , COALESCE(u.cnt, 0) AS "unresolvedHits" FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = s.file_id LEFT JOIN unresolved u ON u.simple_name = s.simple_name WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.outer_symbol_id IS NULL AND s.kind <> 'ANONYMOUS' AND f.path NOT LIKE '%src/test/%' AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT top_id FROM hit) AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT top_id FROM entry) AND s.fqn NOT IN (SELECT x.value FROM analysis_resource x WHERE x.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND x.value IS NOT NULL) AND s.fqn NOT IN (SELECT c.value FROM analysis_config c WHERE c.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND c.value IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (s.kind = 'ANNOTATION' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = s.revision_id AND (a.annotation_fqn = s.fqn OR a.annotation_name = s.simple_name))) ORDER BY s.fqn

WITH RECURSIVE top AS ( SELECT symbol_id, symbol_id AS top_id FROM analysis_symbol WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND outer_symbol_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.symbol_id, t.top_id FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN top t ON s.outer_symbol_id = t.symbol_id WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} ), unresolved AS ( SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM analysis_reference WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND status IN ('UNRESOLVED', 'HEURISTIC') AND ref_kind IN ('CALL', 'METHOD_REF') GROUP BY name ) SELECT m.method_id AS "id" , s.fqn || '#' || m.signature AS "name" , t.top_id AS "topId" , s.layer AS "layer" , f.path AS "path" , m.line_start AS "line" , (SELECT x.value FROM analysis_resource x WHERE x.revision_id = m.revision_id AND x.resource_type = 'METHOD_TITLE' AND x.name = m.method_id LIMIT 1) AS "title" , (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT a.annotation_name, ',') FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = m.revision_id AND a.target_kind = 'METHOD' AND a.target_id = m.method_id) AS "annotations" , COALESCE(u.cnt, 0) AS "unresolvedHits" FROM analysis_method m JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = m.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id JOIN top t ON t.symbol_id = s.symbol_id JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = m.file_id LEFT JOIN unresolved u ON u.name = m.name WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND NOT m.is_constructor AND NOT m.is_synthetic AND s.kind <> 'ANONYMOUS' AND m.name !~ '^(get|set|is)[A-Z0-9_]' AND f.path NOT LIKE '%src/test/%' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = m.revision_id AND r.to_id = m.method_id AND r.from_id <> m.method_id AND r.relation_type <> 'OVERRIDES') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = m.revision_id AND r.from_id = m.method_id AND r.relation_type = 'OVERRIDES') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = m.revision_id AND a.target_id = m.method_id AND a.annotation_name = 'Override') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_endpoint e WHERE e.revision_id = m.revision_id AND e.method_id = m.method_id) ORDER BY s.fqn, m.line_start

WITH hit AS ( SELECT DISTINCT to_id FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL' AND to_id IS NOT NULL ), unresolved AS ( SELECT DISTINCT to_external FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL' AND to_id IS NULL AND to_external IS NOT NULL ) SELECT 'S' || mp.mapper_id AS "id" , CASE WHEN mp.namespace IS NULL OR mp.namespace = '' THEN mp.statement_id ELSE mp.namespace || '.' || mp.statement_id END AS "name" , mp.mapper_type || ':' || COALESCE(mp.statement_type, '') AS "kind" , f.path AS "path" , mp.line_start AS "line" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unresolved un WHERE un.to_external = mp.statement_id OR un.to_external LIKE '%.' || mp.statement_id) AS "unresolvedHits" FROM analysis_mapper mp JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = mp.file_id WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND mp.mapper_type IN ('MYBATIS', 'IBATIS', 'QUERY_XML') AND COALESCE(mp.statement_type, '') <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT' AND f.path NOT LIKE '%src/test/%' AND 'S' || mp.mapper_id NOT IN (SELECT to_id FROM hit) ORDER BY f.path, mp.line_start

SELECT 'F' || f.file_id AS "id" , f.path AS "name" , f.file_type AS "kind" , f.path AS "path" , (SELECT x.value FROM analysis_resource x WHERE x.revision_id = f.revision_id AND x.resource_type IN ('SCREEN_NAME', 'DICT_SCREEN_NAME') AND x.file_id = f.file_id ORDER BY x.resource_type DESC LIMIT 1) AS "title" FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.file_type IN ('JSP', 'WEBSQUARE', 'NEXACRO', 'VUE', 'REACT') AND f.path NOT LIKE '%src/test/%' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = f.revision_id AND r.to_id = 'F' || f.file_id AND r.from_id <> 'F' || f.file_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_endpoint e WHERE e.revision_id = f.revision_id AND e.file_id = f.file_id AND e.endpoint_type = 'JSP') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_resource x WHERE x.file_id = f.file_id AND x.resource_type = 'SCREEN_NAME' AND x.properties_json->>'via' = 'MENU') ORDER BY f.path
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_resource WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND resource_type = 'SCREEN_NAME' AND properties_json->>'via' = 'MENU'

SELECT UPPER(x.name) AS "name" , x.resource_type AS "source" , MAX(x.value) AS "title" , MIN(f.path) AS "path" , MIN(x.line_start) AS "line" FROM analysis_resource x LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = x.file_id WHERE x.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND x.resource_type IN ('DDL_TABLE', 'DICT_TABLE_NAME') AND x.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY UPPER(x.name), x.resource_type
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(to_external) FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE') AND to_external IS NOT NULL
SELECT t.name FROM (VALUES (#{name})) AS t(name) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_mapper mp WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND strpos(UPPER(mp.sql_body), t.name) > 0)
